dialogues.speaker: Skirk
dialogues.text: Not too long ago, I dreamed of a place much like this.

dialogues.speaker: Skirk
dialogues.text: Ever since I mastered the way of rationality, I have forbidden myself from dreaming. All it does is hinder my recovery from training. Yet on occasion, the dreams still come without warning. Sometimes, even rationality cannot fully suppress projections of the subconscious mind.

dialogues.speaker: Skirk
dialogues.text: If I'm honest... what I desire right now is to stay and rest for a while in this tranquil place.
